import com.fasterxml.jackson.module.kotlin.jacksonObjectMapper

fun main() {

    val options = mapper.readValue("{\"debug\":true}", ConversionOptions::class.java)
    val result = HtmlToMarkdown.convert("<p>Debug test</p>", options)
